body:
## Summary

Adds Episode 6 of the AM Podcast to the website. Issue #88 was triaged as a cover-image replacement, but Episode 6 had never actually been added to `main`, so this PR adds the full episode following the ep01–ep05 pattern and uses the **corrected** cover image supplied by @XenonMolecule (not the incorrect one ingested from the RSS feed).

- **`content/episodes/ep06.md`** — "Skills, Memory, Collaboration: What's Next for AI Agents" (`EP06`, date `2026-08-14` from the RSS pubDate, YouTube `6JGWwCr_Gdk`), with a guest blurb wikilinking to the new profile, a `## Timestamps` section, and a `## References` section.
- **`content/people/zora-wang.md`** — guest profile for Zora Wang (CMU) matching the existing people pages, with `Appearances` linking back to `ep06`.
- **`quartz/static/covers/EP06-cover.png`** — corrected cover art (1920×1080 PNG) downloaded from the issue attachment.

## Verification

- Confirmed the downloaded cover is the correct EP06 / Zora Wang art (1920×1080, matching the format of EP00–EP05).
- Ran a full `quartz build` against `content`: succeeds with no errors and no broken-link warnings.
- Verified EP06 appears on the homepage episode carousel and that the `ep06` ↔ `zora-wang` wikilinks resolve in both directions.
- No other episode covers were touched.

Closes #88

## Rubrics Update

No changes were committed to [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #89.

I've reviewed the full PR and issue #88 conversation. Here's my assessment:

**Human interaction:** The only human participant is `XenonMolecule` (association `CONTRIBUTOR`), whose contributions were:
1. A one-off correction that the ingested cover image was wrong, supplying the correct one.
2. An `/approve` command to start the workflow.

Everything else (PR body, implementation summaries, triage) was authored by the `sepo-agent-app` bot, and the only PR issue comment is an automated preview-link from `github-actions[bot]`. There are no PR reviews or review comments.

**Determination:** No durable user/team preference is revealed here. XenonMolecule's image correction is one-off, task-specific feedback (not a repeated pattern, style/workflow rule, or stated future-agent expectation), and their `CONTRIBUTOR` association is untrusted for rubric learning absent a trusted contributor endorsement. The `Requested by` exception doesn't apply because XenonMolecule never authored an explicit request to add/update a rubric within this conversation. There is no existing `/rubrics/` content to update either.

**no rubric changes**
